info.author: xcode
info.comment: Flat vector empty-state illustration: an empty civic desk. A white desk surface, a navy empty inbox tray, a lone gray paperclip, and a faint blue outline of a missing memo. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, white, light gray #E6EBF2. No text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, generous negative space, crisp edges.
